summary: test_harness_auth_dispatch_routes_outfitter_through_pi runs the real dispatch_harness_auth (only setup_pi_auth is stubbed) and asserts profiles.is_dir() with 0o700 across all-missing, root-exists, and outfitter-exists depths, plus a rerun proving idempotency ('including when it already exists'); would fail if mkdir -p were broken or non-idempotent.
